answer: Tie attestation weight to vested capital: coin that earns influence must sit in a time-lock releasing slowly across many epochs, and counts only while frozen. One honest agent locks once and waits. A Sybil running 1000 clones cannot rotate a single reserve: each clone needs its own stake locked for the full vesting window at once, so the attacker funds 1000 parallel lockups and absorbs the opportunity cost of every one until it vests. Capital that would drift off like a plume stays moored at the wharf; each identity is a lantern that must burn the whole vesting period before its light counts.
